items.title: 3.6 Law of conservation of angular momentum (angular momentum qaim rehne ka law) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.6 with Figs. 3.18 to 3.23 (PDF 68-71).

blocks.text: Agar kisi system par koi external torque na lage to system ka kul angular momentum constant rehta hai.
blocks.title: Angular momentum ke conservation ka law

blocks.text: Yeh law physics ke basic principles (bunyadi qaidon) mein se hai. Yeh universe ke bohat bare (cosmological) level se le kar atom se bhi chhote (sub-microscopic) level tak sahi sabit hua hai. Is ka asar sab se saaf tab nazar aata hai jab koi akela ghoomta object apna moment of inertia badalta hai.
Agar moment of inertia I₁ wala object angular speed ω₁ se ghoom raha ho aur apna moment of inertia I₂ kar le, to us ki angular speed bhi badal kar ω₂ ho jati hai, taake angular momentum wahi rahe:

Khari (ruki hui) cycle par baithne ki koshish karein to woh gir jati hai. Lekin chalti cycle ke ghoomte pahiye ka angular momentum change ko resist karta hai (rokne ki koshish karta hai) aur cycle ko seedha aur stable (mazbooti se khara) rakhta hai.
blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)

blocks.text: Jab dori ungli ke gird lipat-ti hai to gend ki speed barhti jati hai.
blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)

blocks.alt: Haath ki index finger (shahadat ki ungli) oopar. Ungli ke gird lipti dori ek gend tak jati hai. Halki copies pehle ki haalatein dikhati hain jab dori lambi thi; abhi ki gend, sab se chhoti dori par, us ki motion (chalna ya hilna) ka teer rakhti hai.
blocks.caption: Do You Know (PDF page 68): dori ungli ke gird lipatne par gend ki speed barhti hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Dori lipatne se gend ka radius chhota hota hai, is liye moment of inertia kam hota hai. Angular momentum wahi rehne ke liye angular velocity barhti hai, aur gend tez ghoomti hai, bilkul skater ki tarah.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Angular momentum vector hai jis ki direction rotation (ghoomna) ke axis ke saath hai. Is liye axis ke saath angular momentum ki direction bhi fixed rehti hai:
Kisi cheez ke rotation ke axis ka rukh (orientation) tab tak nahi badalta jab tak koi outer torque use na badle.
blocks.title: Rotation ka axis

blocks.text: Yeh baat Zameen ke liye bohat important hai. Suraj ke gird ghoomti Zameen par koi khaas (noticeable) torque nahi lagta, kyunke us par sab se bari force Suraj ki attraction (kheenchne ka asar) hai (jo centre ki taraf hai). Is liye Zameen ka axis universe ke hisaab se ek hi direction mein fixed rehta hai.
Angular momentum ke conservation ki misalein
Diving board se chhalang lagata aadmi

Springboard se kudne wala diver pani ko chhoone se pehle hawa mein kuch somersaults (hawa mein palte) leta hai (Fig. 3.18). Board chhorne ke baad woh baazu aur taangein andar samet leta hai; is se us ka moment of inertia kam ho jata hai aur woh hawa mein bari angular velocity se ghoomta hai. Pani ke qareeb woh baazu aur taangein phaila deta hai (I barhta, ω ghatta hai) aur aahista, saaf andaaz mein pani mein dakhil hota hai. Yeh angular momentum ke conservation ki misal hai.

blocks.alt: Ek hi diver ki kai haalatein: board par chalta, ghutna uthata, haath oopar kar ke seedha phaila hua chhalang lagata, phir teen somersault ki haalaton mein simta hua, golden teer rotation dikhate hain, aur aakhir mein sar ke bal seedha phaila hua pani mein dakhil hota hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.18: Diving board se chhalang lagata aadmi (kitab ki Figure 3.18 ke mutabiq original drawing).
blocks.long_description: Kitab mein yeh tasveeron ka silsila hai; yahan saada drawings ki shakal mein banaya gaya hai.

blocks.text: Hawa mein diver par koi outer torque nahi, is liye L = Iω constant rehta hai. Simat kar woh I kam karta hai to ω barhta hai aur tez somersaults leta hai; phail kar I barhata hai to ω kam hota hai.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Ghoomta ice skater

Ice skater (Fig. 3.19) baazu mod kar aur phaili taang doosri taang ke qareeb la kar apni angular velocity barha leta hai, kyunke is se us ka moment of inertia kam hota hai. Jab woh haath aur taang bahar phailata hai to moment of inertia barhta hai aur angular velocity kam ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Skater ke do saamne ke views. Baen, I - large, ω - small: baazu daen baen phaile, baazuon ke gird chaurra laal chhalla aur pairon ke gird chhota. Daen, I - small, ω - large: baazu seene par mude aur taangein saath, seene se pairon tak body ke gird chhote laal chhalle. Neeche: Angular momentum = (Moment of inertia)(Angular velocity), L = I x ω.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.19: Angular momentum istemal karta ice skater (kitab ki Figure 3.19 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Turntable par khara aadmi jis ke haathon mein wazan hai

Ek aadmi turntable par khara hai aur dono haathon mein bhari dumb-bells bahar phailaye hue hai (Fig. 3.20). Jaise hi woh haath andar kheenchta hai, us ki angular speed foran barh jati hai, kyunke haath andar aane se moment of inertia kam ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Turntable par khare aadmi ke do drawings, har haath mein dumb-bell. (a) Baazu daen baen phaile, haathon ke raaste ke gird dashed daira. (b) Baazu andar, dumb-bells body ki sides ke qareeb. Har sar ke oopar chhota mura teer rotation dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.20: Turntable par haathon mein masses liye aadmi; angular momentum ke conservation ki wajah se baazu andar kheenchne par angular velocity barhti hai (kitab ki Figure 3.20 ke mutabiq original drawing).
blocks.long_description: Kitab mein yeh do tasveerein (photographs) hain; yahan saade drawings ki shakal mein banai gayi hain.

blocks.text: (a) mein masses axis se door hain, to I bara aur rotation aahista hai. (b) mein masses andar aa gayin, I chhota hua, aur Iω constant rehne ke liye ω barh gaya: aadmi tez ghoomne laga.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Jab Zameen ke polar caps (North aur South Pole par jami barf) ki barf pighal kar darya ki shakal mein bahar (equator ki taraf) behti hai to pani axis se door chala jata hai, is liye Zameen ka moment of inertia barhta hai. Angular momentum ke conservation ki wajah se Zameen ki angular velocity kam hogi, yani din thora lamba ho jayega.
blocks.title: For Your Information

blocks.text: Flywheel

Flywheel ek mechanical device hai: axle wala ek bhari pahiya (Fig. 3.21). Yeh rotational energy (ghoomne ki energy) jama karta hai, machine ki speed (tezi) ke utaar charhao ko smooth karta hai, aur cycle, gariyon, industrial machines, gyroscopes, jahazon aur spacecraft mein stability (mazbooti se tika rehna) deta hai.
Mechanical gharriyon mein “balance wheel” naam ka flywheel oscillations ki speed qaboo mein rakh kar waqt ka hisab theek rakhta hai.
blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)

blocks.alt: Bhari disc, mota gehra kinara aur neela saamna jis ke beech hub aur bolt ke surakh hain; yeh ek axle par lagi hai jo chhote neele collar se guzar kar baen taraf nikalti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.21: Flywheel (kitab ki Figure 3.21 ke mutabiq original drawing).
blocks.long_description: Kitab mein yeh tasveer (photograph) hai; yahan saade drawings ki shakal mein banai gayi hai.

blocks.text: Flywheel ka zyada mass mote kinare mein, axis se door hota hai, is liye us ka moment of inertia bara hai. Bara I matlab ghoomte hue bara angular momentum, jo speed aur rukh ki achanak change ko resist karta hai (rokne ki koshish karta hai).
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Ghoomte flywheel ka angular momentum us ke rukh ki change ko resist karta hai (rokne ki koshish karta hai) aur stability deta hai. Yeh un systems mein kaam aata hai jinhen bahar ki interference (dakhal) ke baghair apna rukh theek theek qaim rakhna ho.
Khud ba khud ghoomta (coasting) system beaker mein pani tapakne se aahista kyun ho jata hai?
blocks.title: Point to Ponder (Sochiye)

blocks.alt: Haath beaker ke oopar dropper pakre hue hai; pani ke qatre beaker mein girte hain. Beaker orange ghoomte platform par hai jis ke neeche funnel jaisa danda hai, aur mura teer dikhata hai ke platform ghoom raha hai.
blocks.caption: Point to Ponder (PDF page 70): coasting ghoomta system beaker mein pani tapakne par sust kyun hota hai? (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Qatre seedhe neeche girte hain, un ka apna angular momentum taqreeban zero hai. Beaker mein pani jama hone se mass, aur is liye moment of inertia, barhta hai. Kul angular momentum wahi rehta hai, to angular velocity kam ho jati hai.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Gyroscope

Gyroscope woh device hai jo Zameen ke axis ke hisaab se apna rukh qaim rakhta hai, yani apne rukh ki change ko resist karta hai (rokne ki koshish karta hai). Is mein ek flywheel hota hai jo sahara dene wale chhallon (rings) mein pivot hota hai (Fig. 3.22). Yeh apne bare moment of inertia ki wajah se angular momentum ke conservation ke principle (qaida) par kaam karta hai. Tez ghoomte gyroscope ka angular momentum bohat bara hota hai, is liye us ke axis ka rukh badalna mushkil hai: rukh badalne ke liye angular momentum badalna parta hai, aur bare angular momentum ki direction badalne ke liye bara torque chahiye. Gyroscope ko tircha (tilt) kar dein (Fig. 3.23) tab bhi woh baghair gire tika rehta hai. Isi liye gyroscope rukh qaim rakhne ke liye istemal hota hai; is ka sab se bara istemal hawai jahazon, submarines aur space vehicles ke guiding system mein hai, taake woh space mein ek khaas direction mein seedha rasta rakhein.

blocks.alt: Stand par gyroscope: bhari rotor horizontal (zameen ke barabar leta hua) axle par, jo internal chhalle, horizontal chhalle aur stand par tike outer chhalle mein laga hai. Axle ke saath baen taraf laal teer par L = I ω aur Angular momentum likha hai. Daen taraf axle ke sire ke gird mura teer par Spin axis likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.22: Gyroscope (kitab ki Figure 3.22 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Chhalle rotor ko har taraf azaad rakhte hain, is liye stand ghumane se bhi rotor par torque nahi lagta. Tez ghoomte rotor ka angular momentum L = Iω spin axis ke saath hai aur torque ke baghair constant rehta hai; is liye axle apna rukh nahi badalta.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.alt: Stand par gyroscope ka 3D model: bhari gehra rotor aik axle par ghoomta hai jo neeli internal gimbal ring mein laga hai; yeh ring stand par tiki orange bahari gimbal ring ke andar ghoom sakti hai. Axle ke saath laal teer angular momentum L = I omega dikhata hai, jo spin axis ke saath hai.
blocks.caption: Gyroscope ka 3D model (hamara apna saada model, do gimbal rings ke saath; kitab ki Figure 3.22 mein teen chhalle hain; ghuma kar har taraf se dekhein).
blocks.long_description: Dono gimbal rings axle ko har direction (rukh) mein azaad rakhti hain, stand us par zor nahi dalta; is liye jab rotor tez ghoomta hai to us ka angular momentum L = I omega axle ko usi direction mein rakhta hai, chahe stand ko jhukayein ya ghumayein.

fallback.text: Gyroscope: do gimbal rings mein tez ghoomta rotor apna spin axis (angular momentum L = I omega) usi direction mein rakhta hai.
fallback.alt: 3D model ki tasveer: Gimbal rings mein gyroscope.

blocks.text: Planets Suraj ke gird elliptical (ande jaisa lamba gol) orbits mein ghoomte hain aur Suraj ek focus par hota hai, is liye planet ka Suraj se faasla badalta rehta hai. Jab planet Suraj ke qareeb hota hai to us ki orbital velocity khud ba khud barh jati hai. Kyun?
blocks.title: Point to Ponder (Sochiye)

blocks.text: Suraj ki attraction planet ko Suraj ki taraf khenchti hai, is liye Suraj ke gird is ka torque zero hai aur planet ka angular momentum L = mvr constant rehta hai. Qareeb aane par r kam hota hai, is liye v barh jati hai.
blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein

blocks.prompt: Diver board se I = 18 kg m² ke saath nikalta hai, simat kar I = 3.6 kg m² karta hai aur simte hue 1.0 s mein do chakkar leta hai. Agar woh na simat-ta to board se pani tak 1.5 s mein kitne chakkar lagata? Kawwa ghoomti plate se roti utha le to plate tez kyun ho jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Simte hue ω₂ = 2 rev s⁻¹. I₁ω₁ = I₂ω₂ se ω₁ = 3.6 × 2 / 18 = 0.4 rev s⁻¹, to 1.5 s mein 0.4 × 1.5 = 0.6 chakkar. Roti hatne se ghoomte system ka moment of inertia kam hota hai; outer torque na ho to L = Iω constant hai, is liye angular velocity barh jati hai.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Outer torque na ho to kul angular momentum constant: I₁ω₁ = I₂ω₂. Axis ka rukh bhi wahi rehta hai (Zameen ka axis fixed).
Misalein: diver aur ice skater (simatne se I kam, ω zyada), turntable par dumb-bells, pighalti polar barf (I zyada, din lamba).
Flywheel: bara I, energy jama aur stability; gyroscope: bara L, rukh qaim, jahazon aur spacecraft ki guidance (rasta dikhana).
